name: S indicator

statistics.binclass: Does this text possibly contain information about the recent worldwide production of @Element? The date is @Date
statistics.extract: Within the following text, please find the statistic for @Element production.
statistics.name: production

return.date: The year the production was recorded for. Can be empty if you cannot determine.
return.success: True or False, if you were able to extract the information
return.units: The units the production is reported in.

statistics.binclass: Does this text possibly contain information about the recent worldwide reserves of @Element? The date is @Date
statistics.extract: Within the following text, please find the statistic for @Element reserves.
statistics.name: reserve

return.date: The year the reserves was recorded for. Can be empty if you cannot determine.
return.success: True or False, if you were able to extract the information
return.units: The units the reserves is reported in.

statistics.binclass: Does this text possibly contain information about the amount of @Element resources? Resources are typically reported as an estimate of the number of tons of material ore that are undiscovered or unrealized.
statistics.extract: Within the following text, please find the statistic for @Element resources.
statistics.name: resource

return.date: The year the resource was recorded for. Can be empty if you cannot determine.
return.success: True or False, if you were able to extract the information
return.units: The units the resource is reported in.

statistics.binclass: Does this text possibly contain information about the Old Scrap Ratio of @Element? This represents the proportion of scrap material from old sources (end-of-life products) used in the production of new materials.
statistics.extract: Within the following text, please find the statistic for @Element Old Scrap Ratio.
statistics.name: osr

return.date: The year the resource was recorded for. Can be empty if you cannot determine.
return.success: True or False, if you were able to extract the information

statistics.binclass: Does this text possibly contain information about the Recycled Content Ratio of @Element? This indicates the percentage of recycled material in the total input for producing new materials.
statistics.extract: Within the following text, please find the statistic for @Element recycled content ratio.
statistics.name: rcr

return.date: The year the resource was recorded for. Can be empty if you cannot determine.
return.success: True or False, if you were able to extract the information

calculation: return ((100 - 0.2 * (reserve / production) - 0.008 * (reserve / production)**2) + (100 - 0.1 * (resource / production) - 0.002 * (resource / production)**2) + (100 - (osr * rcr / 100))) / 3
